newsitem.title: USA: Simione Central names Jim Henderson CEO.
newsitem.headline: Simione Central names Jim Henderson CEO.

text.p: Simione Central Holdindgs Inc said Monday it has promoted its president, Jim Henderson, to the position of chief executive officer.
Henderson will continue to be president of Simione, a home healthcare information systems company, a company spokeswoman said. He has been president of the company since August 1996.

Gary Bremer, the company's board chairman and former CEO, will continue to focus on building Simione's strategic relationships within the home healthcare industry, along with vice chairman and executive vice president William Siminone Jr, it said.
